_meta: Atomic tool records — one JSON object per line. A tool is an external adapter (binary, MCP server, library) the harness invokes. Distinct from brain/tools.md which is a chronological log; brain/tools.jsonl is the queryable SPOT. Schema: id (T-<name-slug>), name, purpose (≤80 chars), install (one command), invoke (canonical usage), class (array — which vuln classes it serves), provenance (<pack>#<key> or 'native' for mad-hacks-built), verified_at (YYYY-MM-DD when we last confirmed it runs), execution_mode (safe_command|receipt_required|catalog_only|import_only — matches references/arsenal.md). Retrieval telemetry (per user directive) — every tool surfaced via recall logs to brain/telemetry/retrievals.jsonl.

name: CloudRip
purpose: Cloudflare origin-IP discovery via subdomain scanning + IP filter
install: git clone https://github.com/moscovium-mc/CloudRip && cd CloudRip && python3 -m venv venv && source venv/bin/activate && pip install -r requirements.txt

name: beeceptor
purpose: Mock-API with scriptable custom rules for SSRF/webhook OOB with response scripting
install: None — SaaS. Register free tier at beeceptor.com
invoke: Host a beeceptor endpoint that returns 302→169.254.169.254 (SSRF filter bypass via redirect-boomerang) OR a JWT-shaped body pointing to attacker JWKS

name: rbndr.us
purpose: Free public DNS rebinding server for TOCTOU SSRF filter bypass
invoke: printf '%s\n' 7f000001.80808080.rbndr.us  # returns 127.0.0.1 ↔ 8.8.8.8 alternating (TTL=0). Submit as ?url=http://<hostname>/ into the SSRF surface

name: nccgroup/singularity
purpose: Self-hosted DNS rebinding server with custom payloads (when rbndr.us isn't enough)
install: git clone https://github.com/nccgroup/singularity && cd singularity && npm install
invoke: npm start; then visit http://localhost:8080/manager.html to configure rebind target + payloads

name: dalfox v3
purpose: Best-in-class XSS scan/mining/blind — Rust rewrite with native blind-OOB + MCP + SARIF/JSONL
install: cargo install dalfox  # or: brew install dalfox (check version — v3 required)

name: camofox-browser
purpose: Anti-detection stealth browser server for AI agents (Camoufox engine, REST+MCP+OpenAPI, port 9377)
install: git clone https://github.com/jo-inc/camofox-browser packs/camofox-browser && cd packs/camofox-browser && npm install
invoke: ( cd packs/camofox-browser && nohup npm start > /tmp/camofox.log 2>&1 & ); until curl -sSf http://localhost:9377/health; do sleep 1; done
